item.title: Pintola High Protein Oats — Independent Review
item.description: Independent review of Pintola High Protein Oats Dark Chocolate. NC score 5.8/10. 26g protein per 100g from soy+whey blend, ~14g sugar from organic jaggery despite 'no refined sugar' claim. ₹620/kg.

item.title: Avvatar Protein Cold Coffee Drink — Independent Review
item.description: Independent review of Avvatar Protein Cold Coffee Drink. NC score 6.5/10. 15g protein from MPC, zero added sugar, made by Parag Milk Foods — but no third-party testing and protein dose falls short of clinical benchmarks.

item.title: Dymatize ISO 100 Hydrolyzed Whey Protein Isolate — Independent Review
item.description: Independent review of Dymatize ISO 100 Hydrolyzed WPI for India. NC score 7.0/10. NSF Certified for Sport, 25g protein per scoop, but ₹56/g protein makes it the most expensive whey in India.

item.title: MuscleBlaze Biozyme Whey — Re-review (Formulation Updated March 2026)
item.description: MuscleBlaze updated their Biozyme formula in March 2026. We re-ran the full rubric. Score moved from 7.1 to 7.6 — here's what changed and why.
